<script>
(function(){var w=document.currentScript.parentElement;
var btns=w.querySelectorAll(".catalog-toggle-btn");
var views=w.querySelectorAll(".catalog-view");
btns.forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener("click",function(){
btns.forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove("active")});
b.classList.add("active");
var v=b.getAttribute("data-view");
views.forEach(function(v2){v2.style.display=v2.getAttribute("data-view")==v?"":"none"});
});});})();
</script>
